items.title: Merck's $8.4 Billion Keytruda Fortress Gets a 2028 Warning
items.summary: Cipla secured exclusive U.S. commercialization rights to Qilu's proposed biosimilar ahead of Keytruda's expected 2028 patent expiration.

items.title: Summit Packs A Punch For Merck's Keytruda — But Not Everyone Is Sold
items.summary: Summit Therapeutics stock rocketed Thursday after its experimental cancer drug outperformed Merck's blockbuster, Keytruda.

items.title: This $3.2 Billion Novartis Bet Is Not a New Drug. It Is a Better Way to Take One
items.summary: Novartis just committed billions not to discover a new drug but to change how an existing one enters your body. The reason why that quiet engineering bet could matter more than a blockbuster pipeline win is buried in the fine print.

items.title: Healthcare Stocks Pick Up Steam as Investors Play Offense and Defense
items.summary: Drugmakers are getting a boost from strong earnings and M&A. But they’re also havens in a rocky market.

items.title: Moderna’s Cancer Vaccine Rally Sparks Rare Sell Rating and Projected 44% Stock Drop
items.summary: Rothschild analyst Simon Baker downgrades Moderna stock to Sell from Neutral while doubling his price target.

items.title: Does Moderna's mRNA Flu Shot Face a New Challenge From GSK?
items.summary: MRNA's newly approved mFlusiva faces a potential challenge as GSK advances an mRNA flu vaccine targeting two viral proteins.

items.title: Is Merck Stock Pricing In A Post-Keytruda Future Too Soon?
items.summary: Merck’s stock is the top performer in its group, but its profitability sits at the very bottom of the pack, forcing a hard question on investors.

items.title: Summit Therapeutics Says It Is Beating Merck With Its Cancer Drug
items.summary: Summit says its ivonescimab is keeping lung-cancer patients alive longer than Keytruda does. The stock is up.
